question: Four sentences are given, out of which three have all correct spellings. Choose the sentence with the incorrect spelt word/ words.

options.text: Mr. Lloyd a second time produced his snuff-box.
Once he locked me in and was gone three days, it was dreadful lonesum.
It had been his companion for twelve years, always standing on the same spot, always lending its handle to him in the early morning.
How much I wished to reply fully to this question!

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"lonesum"** is an incorrect spelling. The correct spelling is **"lonesome"**. (अकेला)

 
 
• **Example: **She felt **lonesome** after her friends left the city.
 
 
 
• **"Lonesome" **refers to being unhappy because of being alone or without friends. (अकेला)
 
 
• **Example: **The **lonesome** traveler found solace in the quiet countryside.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1**: Mr. Lloyd a second time produced his snuff-box.

 
 
• All words are correctly spelled. (सभी शब्द सही ढंग से लिखे गए हैं)
 
 
 
• **Option 3**: It had been his companion for twelve years, always standing on the same spot, always lending its handle to him in the early morning.
 
 
• All words are correctly spelled. (सभी शब्द सही ढंग से लिखे गए हैं)
 
 
 
• **Option 4**: How much I wished to reply fully to this question!
 
 
• All words are correctly spelled. (सभी शब्द सही ढंग से लिखे गए हैं)
